name: big-file-guard
description: Saves tokens: when the model reads a large data or log file whole, it gets the first lines and a note, unless it asks for a range itself.

enabled.title: Enable big-file-guard
enabled.description: Turn off to let every file be read whole.

maxKb.title: Large file size (KB)
maxKb.description: A csv, tsv, json, jsonl, ndjson, log or txt file bigger than this is cut to its first lines.

headLines.title: Lines shown
headLines.description: How many lines from the top the model gets for a large file.
